physical_hardware: one Blackhole chip on P300c boards
batch_context_semantics: Native context validated at batch 1; batch 4 and 32 correctness/tracing validated with shorter per-user caches. Aggregate capacity depends on caller allocation.

linear_attention.state: fixed convolution history and FP32 recurrent matrix

full_attention.cache: BF16 paged KV, 64-token pages, 4 KV heads, dimension 256

optional_yarn.status: opt-in setup supported; million-token full-layer capacity/accuracy not claimed by this native-context stage

fusion_capacity_validation: Packed BF16 projections, prepared depthwise convolution weights, and temporary L1/sharded rotary layouts retain native capacity. Final fused tests execute both layer kinds through 262144-token prefill and traced decode at position 262143; batch 32 is validated at shorter contexts. KV dtype and recurrent-state dtype are unchanged.
